summary: Former frame cabin (1928) then 20-ft L-4 pole tower (1942) in Kootenai NF 26 mi ESE of Libby; destroyed 1975. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1975, per the lookout listing.

events.note: Frame cabin listed at the site
Listing says the tower was destroyed in 1975

evidence.supports: 26 miles east-southeast of Libby, Lincoln County
Patrol point about half a mile north

notes_for_editor: Only one detailed source (firelookout.com). The FFLA list confirms Gone and coordinates. A YouTube video titled 'Finding a Forgotten Fire Lookout... Abandoned Since 1942' came up in search; its description could not be read and nothing links it to this site, so it is not used. The listing's garbled patrol line ('Patrol 3 miles northeast of on Sheppard') was left out. No usable photo URLs were found. Search and read budget was used in full.
